items.title: IT, Pharma Lead The Charge As Nifty Holds 23,000 | Midcaps Under Pressure | Results Day Action
items.description:
Join us live for Closing Bell as we break down the action on Dalal Street through the final hour of trade. The Nifty is holding above the 23,000 mark and trading near its day’s high, with Nifty IT leading the sectoral charts, up more than 2 percent, followed by solid gains in the pharma space and buying in select healthcare names. The Bank Nifty has stayed largely flat through the session, while the broader market is under pressure, with the Midcap index down nearly 300 points and defence stocks feeling the heat.

It’s also a busy day for earnings reactions, with Trent up around 5 percent after a strong Q2 showing and InterGlobe Aviation gaining after its quarterly numbers. We track the key stock-specific moves, sectoral trends and the triggers that shaped the day’s trade, and what to watch heading into the next session.
